title: Mixing: Band On The Run by Wings | 1974
content:
AIR Studios, London
Engineers: Geoff Emerick, Alan O’Duffy

Wings’ third album, Band On The Run, was remixed on 3 June 1974.

The album had been released towards the end of 1973, but EMI were keen to release it in the then-fashionable quadrophonic format, which utilised four speakers rather than the standard two.

The reissue required new mixes, which were carried out on this day at AIR Studios. None of the members of Wings attended the session.

The quadrophonic edition of Band On The Run was mastered at Abbey Road on 13 June 1974.
